paired.timing: interval-mean gyro; predict to endpoint, then update from the current force vector

initialization.policy: known angle shared by all methods

paired.paired_noise: identical gyro and accelerometer noise for nominal/pulse, shared by every estimator
paired.metric_basis: all original endpoints, including initialization; unwrapped angle error
paired.time_weighted_metric_basis: trapezoidal squared endpoint errors over duration, from original unrounded CSVs; computed by display adapter

controlled.metric_basis: all original endpoints, including initialization; unwrapped angle error
controlled.time_weighted_metric_basis: trapezoidal squared endpoint errors over duration, from original unrounded CSVs; checked against controlled summary
